create_batch_collator: create a BatchCollator instance with a dataset name and dataset type for collating batches
use_batch_collator_call: use the BatchCollator callable to convert a batch into an annotated SampleList with dataset metadata
review_batch_collator_init: review the BatchCollator constructor to understand how dataset_name and dataset_type are stored as instance attributes
refactor_batch_collator: refactor the BatchCollator class to add custom preprocessing before converting the batch to a sample list
test_batch_collator: test the BatchCollator by passing a batch and verifying the returned SampleList has correct dataset_name and dataset_type
